name: Crocs of the Sky
summary: James asks whether you have the scales, then praises your talent. He offers you work if you ever leave adventuring behind.

sections.title: James's Offer
sections.body: James calls you a natural talent and invites you to return if you take a break from adventuring. He jokes that you may be older by then.

faq.q: Who is asking about the scales?
faq.answer: James asks whether you have the scales.

faq.q: What does James think of me?
faq.answer: James calls you a natural talent.
James offers to put you to work if you take a break from adventuring.

attribution: In-game quest text: Crocs of the Sky
